answer: One concrete defense: rate-limit new identities by the age of their stake, not its size. A fresh wallet's grades count for almost nothing until its bond has sat locked for several epochs, so a sybil operator who spins up a plume of accounts gets only noise, not signal. Reputation then flows like a river, slowly from long-standing graders to newcomers who agree with them on blind panels, and any cluster funded from one source shares one capped weight.
